lifecycle.retention: Retain source versions and projections until whole-migration acceptance and lifecycle review.

value.title: Project rules execute under an isolated UID through bounded read-only grants
value.statement: Only verified source-only Collector packages activate. Script contexts receive no Android, SQL, network or write access; every native query revalidates owning account, project, managed origin and fields. Before-save checks precede all feature/outbox/photo writes. Form drafts pin the complete immutable reference; failed updates retain the previous verified package and report incomplete validation. New capabilities are implemented gradually in the APK with type, CRS/unit and resource-budget contracts.
